app.name: TNN Local AI
app.tagline: Your own AI. On your computer.
app.privacy: Nothing you type leaves this device. No account. No cloud.
app.desktopOnly: Open this screen in the desktop app (npm run tauri dev).

welcome.title: Your own AI. On your computer.
welcome.subtitle: Private answers, even without an internet connection. No account. No subscription.
welcome.feature2Body: No graphics card needed. Runs on older laptops.
welcome.feature3Body: We check your PC and suggest a model that fits.

hardware.title: Let's check your PC
hardware.subtitle: We only look at memory, processor and free disk space.
hardware.recommendationBody: This model fits comfortably. We'll set it up with short, quick answers.
hardware.minimumWarning: Your PC is at the minimum. We'll use the smallest model, a short memory and brief answers. Close other apps for the best experience.

model.title: Choose a model
model.subtitle: Bigger models give better answers but need more memory and run slower.
model.experimentalWarning: Experimental models have not passed our quality and speed checks.

download.title: Downloading your model
download.subtitle: One-time download. After this, chat works offline.
download.keepUsing: You can keep using your PC while this downloads.
download.verifyBody: Making sure the download is complete and safe.
download.failedBody: Check your connection and try again. Your progress is saved.

ready.title: Ready. Ask anything.
ready.subtitle: Your AI is set up and stays on this device.
ready.suggestion1: Explain this in simple words: why is the sky blue?
ready.suggestion2: Write a short, friendly email asking to reschedule a meeting.
ready.suggestion3: Give me three easy dinner ideas with what I have: rice, eggs and tomatoes.
ready.speedBody: About {speed} words per second. Short answers will feel quicker.

chat.emptySubtitle: Ask a question, write something, or think out loud. Everything stays on this computer.
chat.suggestion2: Help me write a short message
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
chat.error: The answer could not be completed.
chat.deleteBody: This removes the conversation from this computer. It cannot be undone.
chat.contextWarning: This chat is getting long. Start a new chat if answers slow down.

models.title: Models
models.subtitle: Ultra-light AI models that run without a graphics card.
models.importTitle: Use a model from this computer
models.importBody: Choose a .gguf file. We check the file before adding it.
models.deleteBody: This frees {size}. You can download it again later.
models.tooSmallRam: This PC has {ram}. This model needs about {needed}.
models.experimentalBody: Experimental models are shown for testing. They may be slow or produce poor answers.
models.importFailed: This file could not be imported.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Private by design. Change only what you need.
settings.keepLoadedBody: Keeps the model in memory for instant replies. Uses more memory.
settings.idleUnloadBody: Frees memory when you are not chatting.
settings.clearChatsBody: Deletes every conversation on this computer.
settings.clearConfirm: Delete all conversations? This cannot be undone.
settings.diagnosticsHint: Creates a zip with system details. Prompts and API keys are not included.
settings.benchmarkHint: Runs a short, local test to estimate speed.
settings.advancedWarning: These settings can make answers slower or break them. Change one at a time.
settings.threadsHint: Use your physical core count. More is often slower on older PCs.
settings.contextHint: Larger values let the AI remember more, but use more RAM and slow the first reply.
settings.systemPromptHint: Short instructions work best. Leave the default if unsure.
settings.showReasoningHint: Off by default. Reasoning can be very slow on this class of PC.

hardware.minimumBody: This PC meets the minimum. The app will use short contexts and brief answers.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Try again, or export diagnostics if it keeps happening.

codes.engine_spawn_failed: The AI engine could not start. Check that the app was installed correctly.
codes.engine_crash: The AI engine stopped unexpectedly. Restart it and try again.
codes.engine_timeout: The AI engine took too long to start. Try a smaller model or close other apps.
codes.engine_illegal_instruction: This PC is missing a feature the AI engine needs. Try compatibility mode.
codes.engine_garbage_output: The AI engine produced invalid output. Restart it and try again.
codes.engine_port_conflict: The AI engine could not open a local connection. Restart the app.
codes.model_not_installed: This model is not installed yet.
codes.model_not_found: The model file is missing. Download it again.
codes.model_corrupt: The model file is damaged. Download it again.
codes.model_unsupported: This model is not supported on this PC. Choose a smaller one.
codes.model_unvalidated: This model has not passed validation yet.
codes.disk_full: There is not enough free space for this model. Free some space first.
codes.download_failed: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
codes.download_checksum: The download was incomplete or damaged. Try again.
codes.download_blocked: This download source is not allowed by the app.
codes.out_of_memory: This model needs more memory than is free. Close other apps or choose a smaller model.
codes.context_overflow: This conversation is too long for the model's memory. Start a new chat or reduce memory in Settings.
codes.unsupported_platform: This version of the app does not support this PC.
codes.storage_error: The app could not read or write its data. Export diagnostics for details.
codes.network_error: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
codes.invalid_input: Something in the request was not valid. Change it and try again.
